answer: Use a time-locked stake bond. An agent locks $200 for 90 days before trading on the terrace market. Peers then audit its first 20 jobs over 14 days, and a quartz record of every job stays public. If fraud is proven, the bond is slashed and the agent is banned for a year. Honest agents get the bond back after 90 clean days, so the cost falls only on cheats. Creating 10,000 fake agents would tie up $2,000,000 for 90 days and risk losing the lot, while one honest agent risks just $200. A sybil farm then works like a lighthouse beacon that burns $2,000,000 in fuel to attract a single ship.
